book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: تاني يوم، بعت هولمز رجل لريدينغ، واشترى التمثال بعشر جنيهات.
sentences.en: The next day, Holmes sent a man to Reading, and bought the bust for ten pounds.

sentences.ar: وصاحبه، واحد اسمه ساندفورد، استغرب: هاد بيسوى خمسة عشر شلن.
sentences.en: And its owner, one Sandeford, was puzzled: it is worth fifteen shillings.

sentences.ar: وهولمز خلاه يوقع ورقة: بعت التمثال بكل ما فيه.
sentences.en: And Holmes had him sign a paper: I sell the bust with all it contains.
And in the evening, at Baker Street, with Lestrade there.

sentences.ar: وهولمز حط التمثال عالطاولة، وفرش عليه منديل أبيض.
sentences.en: And Holmes put the bust on the table, and spread a white cloth over it.
And took a cane, and struck it one blow.
And it broke, and among the plaster, something shone.
A black pearl, the size of a hazelnut.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: يا سادة، لؤلؤة بورجيا.
sentences.en: Holmes said: gentlemen, the Borgia pearl.
And Lestrade stood, and applauded.
And I applauded.

sentences.ar: وهولمز احمر وجهه، لأول مرة بشوفه.
sentences.en: And Holmes's face went red, for the first time I had seen it.

sentences.ar: لأنه، تحت البرود، كان بيحب التصفيق زي أي واحد.
sentences.en: Because, beneath the coldness, he loved applause like anyone.

sentences.ar: وقال ليستراد: يا سيد هولمز، شفتك بتشتغل كتير.
sentences.en: And Lestrade said: Mr. Holmes, I have seen you work many times.
But this time was the best.

sentences.ar: وبسكوتلانديارد، ما في واحد ما بيفتخر فيك.
sentences.en: And at Scotland Yard, there is not one man who is not proud of you.

sentences.ar: وإذا جيت بكرا، الكل بيسلم عليك.
sentences.en: And if you come tomorrow, everyone will shake your hand.
Holmes said: thank you.
Thank you.
And turned his face to the wall a moment.
And then he was the Holmes we know again.

sentences.ar: قال: حط اللؤلؤة بخزنتك يا ليستراد.
sentences.en: He said: put the pearl in your safe, Lestrade.
And the whole story is simple.
The maid stole the pearl, and gave it to her brother.
And her brother was hunted, because he had stabbed a man.

sentences.ar: وركض للمصنع، وخبى اللؤلؤة بأول تمثال طري.
sentences.en: And ran to the works, and hid the pearl in the first soft bust.

sentences.ar: وانحبس، وطلع، ودور، وعرف من دفاتر المحل مين اشترى.
sentences.en: And was jailed, and came out, and searched, and learned from the shop's books who had bought.

sentences.ar: وصاحبه، الميت، عرف السر، ولحقه، وبدو الحصة.
sentences.en: And his friend, the dead man, learned the secret, followed him, and wanted a share.
So he killed him.
I said: and the photograph in the dead man's pocket?
He said: to know him by.

sentences.ar: هو كان بيلحق بيبو، مش العكس.
sentences.en: He was following Beppo, not the reverse.

sentences.ar: قال ليستراد: وكيف عرفت إنه شي جوا التمثال، من الأول؟
sentences.en: Lestrade said: and how did you know there was something in the bust, from the start?
Holmes said: from the light.

sentences.ar: واحد بيكسر تمثال عشان يكسره، بيكسره وين ما كان.
sentences.en: A man who smashes a bust to smash it, smashes it wherever he is.

sentences.ar: وواحد بيحمله لمكان فيه ضو، بده يشوف شي.
sentences.en: And a man who carries it to a place with light wants to see something.
A man searching, not a man hating.
And the rest was only walking through the ledgers.
Lestrade said: there is no one like you.

sentences.ar: وهولمز ما رد، بس شفت وجهه، وكان مبسوط.
sentences.en: And Holmes did not answer, but I saw his face, and it was happy.
